equity.equity_measurement: Rurality is the county-of-residence NCHS six-level urban-rural scheme; rates are age-adjusted and shown separately by sex.

ev.q: In 2020, age-adjusted suicide rates among females increased as the level of urbanization declined, from 4.6 per 100,000 population in large central metropolitan areas
but were similar for small metropolitan, micropolitan, and noncore areas.

notes: The six urbanization levels are inferred from the NCHS scheme; the text names four of them. Claims such as 'similar' and 'increased' may implicitly rest on the CI error bars, but no overlap rule or test is stated, so no test is recorded.
